dynamic_fields.preflight_id: generated diagnostic correlation ID, not an action ID
dynamic_fields.timestamp: Runtime report UTC; not a replacement for evidence source time
dynamic_fields.nodes: per-node same-session fresh heartbeat/disarmed and landed freshness, RX/heartbeat health, busy state
dynamic_fields.home_evidence: post-request HOME_POSITION plus fresh aligned global/local crosscheck; null if not queried
dynamic_fields.rtl_destination_evidence: post-query RTL_TYPE and rally count; null if not queried
dynamic_fields.ground_context: currently fresh accepted producer ground reference and selected node calibration/run binding
